algorithm: etag = "1:" || base64url_unpadded( SHA-256( JCS( project(occasion, PROJECTION_0_1) ) ) )

pointer_syntax.extension: The token `-` denotes EVERY element of the array at that position, in document order. RFC 6901 reserves `-` for the nonexistent element after the last; it can never name a real member, so reusing it as the each-element token introduces no ambiguity. Arrays project in document order, which is why `offers` must be emitted sorted by offer_id under C collation.

closure_rule: A member not named here is EXCLUDED. A future version adding a member MUST name it here or it is excluded by default, and adding one is a MAJOR under V2.

excluded_and_why.prose values: A typo fix cannot invalidate an estate's in-flight resolutions. ONE EXCEPTION, enumerated in SPEC.md §2.2 and resolved in docs/2026-08-25-cx-01-spec-first.md: /work/title/value IS projected, because the title is the assertion about WHICH FILM, and a silent swap of the work must move the etag.
excluded_and_why.revision: MUST increase strictly monotonically on every publish; only etag carries an assertion change.
excluded_and_why.instant.feature_at, instant.ends_at: Policy arithmetic over an ad reel and a runtime, drifting for reasons that are not assertions about the screening.
excluded_and_why.etag: A digest cannot be inside its own preimage.

catches: a changed price or price basis
a withdrawn or added non-substitutability assertion
